optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           ra.ca_state AS ctr_state,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM catalog_returns AS cr
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk
          FROM date_dim
          WHERE d_year = 2001) AS dd
      ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address AS ra
      ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ra.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk,
             ra.ca_state
),
state_threshold AS (
    SELECT ctr_state,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       addr.ca_street_number,
       addr.ca_street_name,
       addr.ca_street_type,
       addr.ca_suite_number,
       addr.ca_city,
       addr.ca_county,
       addr.ca_state,
       addr.ca_zip,
       addr.ca_country,
       addr.ca_gmt_offset,
       addr.ca_location_type,
       ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1
JOIN state_threshold AS st
  ON ctr1.ctr_state = st.ctr_state
 AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > st.avg_total_return
JOIN customer AS c
  ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address AS addr
  ON addr.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
WHERE addr.ca_state = 'TN'
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id,
         c.c_salutation,
         c.c_first_name,
         c.c_last_name,
         addr.ca_street_number,
         addr.ca_street_name,
         addr.ca_street_type,
         addr.ca_suite_number,
         addr.ca_city,
         addr.ca_county,
         addr.ca_state,
         addr.ca_zip,
         addr.ca_country,
         addr.ca_gmt_offset,
         addr.ca_location_type,
         ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
